headline: Somi Conveyor Beltings submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Standard compliance filing by Somi Conveyor
summary: Somi Conveyor Beltings Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine post-AGM regulatory compliance filing required of all listed companies. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural update has no financial impact on the company's valuation or stock price.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact for retail investors.
